extraction.text:
Gyanendra Singh
Senior Software Engineer
Email –singhamgyanendra@gmail.com | +91 8116734503 | LinkedIn

Professional Summary

Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience in designing, developing, and optimizing Java-based applications. Expertise in Spring Boot, Microservices, Cloud Computing, and Database Management. Proven ability to enhance security, automate processes, and drive high-performance scalable solutions. Strong background in Agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps.

Work Experience

Genpact (Western Union & Macquarie) – Lead Consultant

Aug 2022 – Present

Spearheaded development of microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Kafka, enabling scalable event-driven architecture for financial transaction processing.

Led the complete cloud migration of a core banking service to AWS, utilizing EC2, S3, and RDS, resulting in 35% cost optimization and improved scalability.

Designed and developed RESTful APIs for secure user onboarding, integrating Spring Security, JWT authentication, and MongoDB for flexible data storage.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes, ensuring zero-downtime deployments and rapid rollbacks across staging and production.

Built an internal DevOps utility tool using Java and Shell scripts, enhancing deployment governance and reducing manual intervention by 60%.

Engineered a Kafka-based asynchronous permissioning system (DCM Agent) to decouple services and improve system resiliency under high-load conditions.

TCS – Senior Software Engineer

Apr 2016 – Aug 2022

Designed and implemented an order management platform using Spring Boot and Hibernate, integrating PostgreSQL as the primary data store and Redis for session management.

Architected microservices for a logistics client, breaking down a monolith into containerized services managed through Docker and Kubernetes, reducing release time by 50%.

Developed ETL data pipelines using Java and Apache Kafka to stream transactional data across distributed systems in near real-time.

Contributed to modernization of a legacy application by refactoring core modules with Spring WebFlux for reactive programming and enhanced performance.

Created JUnit and Mockito-based unit and integration test suites, achieving over 85% code coverage and ensuring reliable, maintainable codebase.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile sprints, managing end-to-end delivery of features, code reviews, and production releases.

Education

NIT Durgapur – B.Tech, Computer Science
2011 – 2015



Languages & Programming Concepts

Languages: Java (Core & Advanced), Shell Script

Core CS: Data Structures, Algorithms, Design Patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer)

Design: Low-Level Design (LLD), High-Level Design (HLD)

Frameworks & Libraries

Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, JPA, Spring Security, AOP

WebFlux (Reactive programming), Apache Kafka (Messaging)

Microservices & API Development

RESTful APIs, Service Discovery, API Gateway

Circuit Breaker, Load Balancing, Config Server

Database Technologies

SQL: PostgreSQL, Sybase

NoSQL: MongoDB

ORM Tools: Hibernate, JPA

Cloud & DevOps

Cloud Platforms: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)

Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes

CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, Git, Maven, Gradle

Testing & Quality Assurance

JUnit, Mockito, Integration Testing, Test-Driven Development (TDD)

Development Practices

Agile Methodologies: Scrum, Sprint Planning, Retrospectives

Version Control: Git

Build Tools: Maven, Gradle

Certifications & Achievements

Recognized at Genpact for excellence in security module enhancements.

Led a critical database migration project, reducing downtime by 40%.
